d: When her dog is killed, Tara cancels her wedding. But her dog's ghost and her small town have a surprise.
When Isla's art unexpectedly sells to Mark, a second commission sees them falling in love.
A retired pro boxer, now a school janitor, tries to help a new student, who is being targeted by bullies.
Sparks fly between Jenny and Nate at a corporate retreat, despite him being her boss's brother.
